sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:47546
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1675 of 2024

Applicant :- Rajnath Dubey
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Raghuvansh Misra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Tiwari
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Brijesh Pratap Singh, learned Aga for the State apprised the Court that he has received
instructions in the present matter, therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application may be
disposed of on merit.
2. Heard Sri Raghuvansh Misra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rajesh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the complainant and Sri Brijesh Pratap Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Complaint Case No. 1306 of 2021, under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Bhadohi,
District Bhadohi, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

4. A complaint was filed against applicant and two others on 19.11.2020 and applicant was summoned on 01.05.2023 and according to the complaint, by playing fraud, applicant with the help of other accused persons, changed the caste of the complainant in the revenue record from 'Gond' to 'Kahar'.

Rajnath Dubey vs State Of U.P. on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162146562/

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, complainant filed criminal complaint against the applicant and admittedly as per the allegation, the forgery was made in the revenue record and applicant is a practicing Advocate and he is not having any concern with the maintenance of the revenue record and he was not in a position to make any forgery in the record and this fact clearly suggests that only due to previous enmity on the basis of false allegation,
applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
6.

He further submitted that applicant was summoned on 01.05.2023 and thereafter in month of June, 2023, he filed an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. before this Court against the summoning order but no interim order could be passed in his favour and in the meantime on 07.10.2023 bailable warrant was issued against the applicant and thereafter on 11.12.2023 NBW was issued against the applicant and thereafter when applicant filed anticipatory bail application before the court concerned then his application has been dismissed.
7.

He further submitted that when on 17.01.2024 anticipatory bail application of the applicant was dismissed by the court concerned then thereafter on 12.02.2024 process under Section 82 Cr.P.C.
was issued against him but applicant is not an absconder and he was continuously seeking the legal remedy available to him and he filed instant anticipatory bail application before this Court on 15.02.2024.

8. He further submitted that applicant was summoned in complaint case and his custodial interrogation does not appear to be necessary and applicant is having apprehension, if he will appear before the court concerned then he will be sent to jail.

9. He further submitted that applicant is a practicing Advocate and is having good reputation and if he will be sent to jail then his entire career and image will be ruined, therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, he may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
10.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that applicant is the person, who by playing fraud, changed the caste of the complainant in the revenue record but they fairly conceded the fact that except the bald and verbal allegation, there is no evidence in the regard.
They further could not dispute the fact that applicant has been summoned in a complaint case.

11. However, learned counsel for the complainant vehemently submitted that applicant is an absconder and summons were issued on 01.05.2023 but till date, he did not appear before the court concerned and ultimately on 12.02.2024 court concerned has to issue process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. against him and, therefore, considering the conduct of the applicant, he should not be released on anticipatory bail.
12. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. It is a case in which, applicant, who is a practicing Advocate, was summoned by the court concerned in a complaint case on 01.05.2023 and thereafter it appears that he approached this Rajnath Dubey vs State Of U.P. on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162146562/
2 Court in the month of June, 2023 by way of filing an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
14.

entities.text: Rajnath Dubey vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: From the record, it also reflects that earlier complainant of the present case also approached this Court under the jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and both the applications were connected by this Court but till date, no order could be passed and both the applications are still pending but in the meantime on 07.10.2023 bailable warrant was issued against the applicant and thereafter NBW was issued.

It appears that applicant filed anticipatory bail application before the court concerned but on 17.01.2024 his anticipatory bail application was dismissed by the court concerned and thereafter on 15.02.2024, he filed instant anticipatory bail application before this Court but in the meantime on 12.02.2024 process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. was issued
, therefore, this Court finds force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is not an absconder as he was continuously seeking the legal remedy available to him.

15. As far as merit of the case is concerned, allegation against the applicant is that he by playing fraud, changed the caste of the complainant in the revenue record but applicnat is not public servant and he is a practicing Advocate and except the bald allegation, there is no evidence on record, which can show that applicant is the person, who by playing fraud changed the caste of the applicant in the revenue record.
16.

Further, applicant has been summoned in complaint case and in complaint case, there is hardly any need of custodial interrogation and apprehension of custody raised by the applicant, cannot be completely brushed aside.
17. Further, applicant is an practicing Advocate and he is not having any criminal history.
18. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of trial.
19. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

22. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
